invest.headline: Invest directly into verified operations — with tracked execution.
invest.subtext: Exportunity enables investors to fund real businesses operating on the platform. Capital is tied to a digital contract, released by milestones, and spent through platform-native purchases so execution and returns remain visible.
invest.disclaimer: Returns are modeled, not guaranteed. Investments involve risk.
invest.opportunitiesLead: Explore SMEs, farms, production units, machinery projects, and commodity workflows with contract-level controls and reporting.
